newsitem.title: USA: LCRA delays Ferguson, Texas gas plant restart.
newsitem.headline: LCRA delays Ferguson, Texas gas plant restart.

text.p: Lower Colorado River Authority (LCRA) has delayed restarting its 430 megawatt Ferguson natural gas-fired power plant until later this week or perhaps early next week, a company spokeswoman said.
"We're not going to be able to start it today, hopefully we will restart tomorrow, but it may even be Monday (Oct 21)," company spokeswoman Merrell Foote said Wednesday.
The Marble Falls, Texas unit was shut October 11 to repair a boiler tube leak.
Company officials had said they expected repairs to be complete in about five days, but Foote said a restart had to be delayed to test welds used in the repair.
The Ferguson facility produces eight percent of LCRA's power output.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
